profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing, scaling, and deploying high-throughput enterprise systems, microservices, and AI-driven applications. Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, Distributed Systems, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/Azure), and Machine Learning. Proven track record of delivering 99.99% system availability, scaling systems for 100K+ daily users, and engineering large-scale streaming/data pipelines. Talent for cooperating and collaborating with elite technical and cross-functional teams through complete Software Development Life Cycle using Agile Methodology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
The largest pay-TV company, the largest cable TV company and largest home Internet service provider in the US.
Recruited to assist in building new APIs and development of features for Comcast's products.

Technologies Used: Java 21, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, MySQL, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, AWS, Cloud Foundry, Docker, Kubernetes / EKS, Git, Apache Maven, Jenkins, Concourse CI, Terraform, FluxCD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer of AI applications for the healthcare industry.
Recruited to assist in building enterprise labeling and AI radiology assistant systems for healthcare clients.
 
Technologies Used: Java 11, Spring Framework, Hibernate, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, ReactJS, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Apache Maven, Jenkins

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Digital Banking group specializing in serving under-banked and under-served communities, with operations in Vietnam, South Africa and Singapore.
Recruited to play key role on technical team focused on building South Africa’s 1st digital banking. Served as key developer implementing major systems for Digital Banking System.
 
Technologies Used: Java 8, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, MySQL, AWS, WSO2 API Gateway, Mambu Core Banking, Apache Kafka, Vault, Docker, Rancher, Git, Apache Maven, Bitbucket, JFrog, TeamCity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Internet technology company and Vietnamese start-up valued at $1 billion.
Assisted in research and development of Content Delivery Network, Live Video Streaming platform.   

Technologies Used: Java, Linux Shell Script, Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, Apache Thrift, ExtJS, Liferay, Hazelcast, Memcached, Wowza Streaming Engine, EagleDNS, Jetty, Nginx, SVN, Apache Ant, FFmpeg, Jenkins
